name: SIA Engineering Company Limited
summary: SIA Engineering Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services in Singapore, Philippines, Japan, Malaysia, Cambodia, and the United States of America. The company operates through Airframe and Line Maintenance; and Engine and Component segments. The Airframe and Line Maintenance segment offers airframe maintenance, including scheduled routine maintenance and overhaul, specialized and non-routine maintenance, and modification, and refurbishment services; line maintenance that provides aircraft certification, and technical ground handling services, such as push-back and towing, as well as aircraft ground support equ…
